info.name: Bicycle MRP - Items API Tests
info.description: Newman-ready integration test collection for Items CRUD endpoints. Run sequentially against a disposable/test database. The first request creates a seed item; later requests reuse its ID. Pagination is intentionally not tested. The collection assumes the API response envelope and error codes shown in the supplied source.
